clue.text: Fixed salary used to stop free wheeling

definitions.note: the definition describes what the thing does, standing for the noun

parts.note: something fixed in place is set
screw is old British slang for wages or salary

explanation.surface: A fixed wage is being used to rein in someone's free-wheeling spending habits.
explanation.walkthrough: SCREW as a word for pay is dated British slang. The definition is descriptive: the device is a small screw that locks a wheel or collar onto a shaft so it cannot spin freely.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of screw clamps a wheel or pulley to its shaft, preventing it from turning loosely.

clue.text: Not even accommodated in reserved goods of low quality

indicators.note: accommodated in means housed within, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a reserved person is shy
a number that is not even is odd

explanation.surface: Uneven items are kept in a store of cheap, poorly made stock.
explanation.walkthrough: As a noun the answer is cloth made from recycled wool, and by extension inferior goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Originally recycled woollen cloth, the word came to mean inferior merchandise or anything cheaply made.

clue.text: Divine faith is embraced by others

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: them refers to other people, the others

explanation.surface: A religious belief is taken up by other people.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief in a god or gods is the doctrine of a divine being, a faith in the divine.

clue.text: Five in custody have to cut patterns

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the word for custody

parts.note: to have custody of someone is to have them in your care
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Five prisoners in detention pass the time carving designs.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut shapes or designs into wood or stone.

clue.text: Common Market subject is out of place

parts.note: the European Community, once called the Common Market, is abbreviated EC
a subject of discussion is a topic

explanation.surface: A topic about the European trading bloc is deemed irrelevant.
explanation.walkthrough: The Common Market was the popular British name for the European Economic Community.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine an ectopic pregnancy or organ is one located in an abnormal position.

clue.text: A soft fruit is to emerge

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical abbreviation for soft
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a squishy piece of fruit is about to come out.
explanation.definitionFit: To come into view is to emerge, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Outspoken argument makes him bring a suit

definitions.note: the definition describes a person, the one who brings a lawsuit, standing for the noun

parts.note: plain speaking is frank and outspoken
a tiff is a minor argument

explanation.surface: A frank row leads a man to sue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' looks like clothing but means a lawsuit; the definition names the person who brings one.
explanation.definitionFit: In law the party who starts a civil action is the one bringing the case against a defendant.

clue.text: East European is insane to riot

indicators.note: riot as a verb means to run wild, so the letters before it are scrambled

explanation.surface: A Baltic native says it is mad to start a riot.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Estonia, a Baltic state in eastern Europe, is a native of that country.

clue.text: Motor racing is picking up

definitions.meaning: a form of motorsport run over public or forest roads in stages
recovering, as a market or patient picks up

explanation.surface: Interest in motorsport is growing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rallies are road-based motorsport events; to rally is also to recover strength, as a share price does.

clue.text: Exaggerate the batting team's complaint against slow bowling

definitions.meaning: to exaggerate a thing's worth is to rate it too highly

definitions.text: the batting team's complaint against slow bowling
definitions.meaning: in cricket the number of overs bowled per hour is the ..., and a slow one is a common grievance

explanation.surface: A cricket side moans about how slowly the opposition bowls its overs.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls; the over rate is how many are bowled per hour, and a fielding side bowling slowly costs the batsmen time.
explanation.definitionFit: To value something more highly than it deserves is an inflated judgement; in cricket the phrase also names the pace of bowling overs.

clue.text: Price-control association returns permit to motoring club

indicators.note: returns asks for the whole run of permit and motoring club to be read backwards

parts.note: to permit is to let
the RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motoring organisation

explanation.surface: A motoring club hands back a permit it had been issued.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns the whole run LETRAC backwards. The RAC is Britain's Royal Automobile Club, which offers breakdown cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of firms colluding to fix prices is a cartel, an association that controls what is charged.

clue.text: Rummage for food

definitions.meaning: to dig or search about
informal slang for food

explanation.surface: Someone forages around for something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: To dig about searching, and a slang word for something to eat.

clue.text: Hard pad for paint

definitions.meaning: hard pad is an old name for a form of the canine viral disease that hardens dogs' paws
a water-based paint for walls and scenery

explanation.surface: A request for something firm to rest on while painting.
explanation.definitionFit: The canine illness once called hard pad shares its name with a glue-based wall paint used in decorating.

clue.text: Grandmother keeps girl in New York

indicators.note: in puts the girl's name inside the abbreviation for the city

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An older woman looks after her granddaughter in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps' looks like the container signal for Grandmother holding a girl, but Grandmother is the definition and 'keeps' merely links it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Nanny is an affectionate informal name children use for their grandmother.

clue.text: Some of the church icons show style

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some religious images in the church display elegance.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'show style' as the definition, but the answer means style or stylish; 'show' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means elegance and fashionable flair, a synonym for style.

clue.text: Offer to maintain garrison hospital

parts.note: to maintain something is to hold it
a fort is a garrisoned stronghold

explanation.surface: An offer to keep a military hospital running.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase usually means to speak at length, but its older sense is to hold out or offer something.
explanation.definitionFit: In its older sense the phrase means to hold out or propose something, as one would extend an offer.

clue.text: Community member has to bear it in mind

indicators.note: in places the small word it within the word for mind

parts.note: the mind is the brain

explanation.surface: A member of a community has to keep a matter in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: When this was set the country belonged to the European Community, which is what 'Community' refers to.
explanation.definitionFit: The United Kingdom was a member state of the European Community, so it fits as a member nation.

clue.text: Do exercises to relax

definitions.meaning: to limber up with stretches before activity
to become less tense

explanation.surface: Advice to work out in order to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: Stretching muscles before exertion, and becoming less tense or uptight.

clue.text: Restrict production of nitrates

indicators.note: production of suggests making something new from raw material, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Limits are placed on fertiliser output.
explanation.definitionFit: To straiten is to confine or narrow, as in straitened circumstances, which restrict.

clue.text: Two foul compounds found in effluent

indicators.note: compounds as a verb means mixes together, so the letters are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: Two foul-smelling chemical compounds are detected in waste water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compounds' reads as a chemistry noun but is a verb signalling the mixing of TWO and FOUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Effluent is liquid waste flowing out of a plant or drain, an outward discharge.

clue.text: Fancy man understands the little woman

indicators.note: read as under stands, it places the man piece below the woman piece in this down clue

parts.note: W is an abbreviation for woman, the little meaning shortened
him stands for a man

explanation.surface: A lover realises the wife's feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'understands' splits as 'under stands': in a down answer HIM stands under W. 'Fancy man' looks like a lover, but 'Fancy' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy, as a sudden notion or impulse, is a whim.

clue.text: It provides food containing calcium and iron

parts.note: Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A dietary claim about something that serves meals rich in minerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A small restaurant serving snacks and drinks provides food to customers.

clue.text: Strike is to be made public

definitions.meaning: to go on strike, to walk out of work
to become known

explanation.surface: Industrial action is about to be announced.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers who down tools are said to walk off the job, and news that becomes known emerges.

clue.text: Socially ill at ease when left in France

definitions.meaning: awkward in company
the French word for left

explanation.surface: Someone feels awkward when abandoned in France.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for left-handed or left gives English its word for clumsy and tactless.

clue.text: Mean to be spotted

definitions.meaning: stingy or contemptibly small
infected with measles, covered in spots

explanation.surface: Being stingy marks one out.
explanation.definitionFit: A paltry, stingy amount, and literally having the spotty rash of the childhood disease.

clue.text: Pole needs to supply personnel

definitions.meaning: a long stick or rod
to provide workers for an organisation

explanation.surface: A Polish worker is needed to help provide staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A stick carried for support or as a symbol, and the verb meaning to provide an organisation with workers.

clue.text: One Frenchman has to intervene without delay

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman
to mediate is to intervene in a dispute

explanation.surface: A lone Frenchman must step in to settle a dispute at once.
explanation.walkthrough: M is short for Monsieur, the French equivalent of Mr.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening without delay is instant, an adjectival sense of the definition.

clue.text: Informally polite refusal by railway clerk

parts.note: no ta is a casual British way of saying no thanks, ta being slang for thank you

explanation.surface: A railway clerk turns something down with casual courtesy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ta' is everyday British slang for thanks, so 'no ta' is a polite but casual refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal official who witnesses and certifies documents, historically a kind of clerk or scribe.

clue.text: Congregates for prayers

definitions.meaning: gathers together in one place
short set prayers in Anglican and Catholic services, assigned to particular days

explanation.surface: A churchgoing scene: a crowd gathers to pray.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means gathers together, and in church liturgy the noun names short prayers said on set days.

clue.text: Forceful but feeble-framed man of honour

indicators.note: framed means surrounded, so the weak word is placed around the honour abbreviation

parts.note: puny means feeble or weak
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A forceful man of honour turns out to have a weak physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feeble-framed' looks like a description of a body, but 'framed' is the container signal; the Companion of Honour is a British award.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigorous, punchy writing or speech hits hard, so it is forceful.

clue.text: Plan of action to get trays manufactured

indicators.note: manufactured means made or put together, so these letters are rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A business plan for getting serving trays produced.
explanation.definitionFit: A strategy is an overall scheme for achieving a goal, a plan of campaign.
